name: Viral Drake
oracle_text:
Flying
Infect (This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.)
{3}{U}: Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
blocked_sentences: {3}{U}: Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

needs.what: a proliferate op (701.34) where the controller chooses any number of permanents AND/OR players (any controller) that have counters, then each chosen one gets one more counter of each kind already there -- including poison counters on opponents, which is the whole point on an infect card
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The existing `proliferate` op is a simplification: it offers no choice and never touches players or opponents' permanents, so it cannot add poison counters to an opponent and would put counters on things the controller would decline (e.g. -1/-1 counters on their own creatures)
